properties.name: Blackhall Manor
properties.note: According to Obadiah Blackhall, the mansion has been in his family for generations, dating back to long before the Great War, and is a "fine example of Victorian architecture." He intends to keep this tradition alive, staying in the estate until he dies or the swampfolk get him.

properties.name: Calvert Mansion
properties.note: The Calvert Mansion is a large Victorian mansion located in Point Lookout. It is inhabited by Desmond Lockheart, a 200 year-old ghoul from before the Great War.

properties.name: Galaxy News Radio
properties.note: Galaxy News Radio is a building in Washington, D.C. It is home to the radio broadcast of the same name, and also functions as a Brotherhood of Steel base.

properties.name: Rock Falls
properties.note: Following the extermination of the raider camp in Freeport, the leaders of the various raider groups in the Midwest decided to hold a conference to decide on a method of dealing with the expanding Brotherhood forces, and to attempt to come to some sort of agreement on facing the mysterious menace rising in the west. Rock Falls was attacked and decimated by the Brotherhood of Steel during the meeting

properties.name: Osceolla
properties.note: Osceolla was the main base of operations of Gammorin's (Paladin Latham's) super mutant army. It was a military compound constructed near the place where part of the Brotherhood of Steel Air Convoy crashed.

properties.name: Appleton
properties.note: Appleton is a pre-war city in Wisconsin that survived the Great War. Beginning in 2171, the inhabitants began holding local contests, ranging from the mundane "Throw The Spear" to the bizarre "Most likely to stay a Virgin".

properties.name: Great Bend
properties.note: Before the Great War, Great Bend was the largest city and county seat of Barton County, Kansas and a major center of industry. Now, it is a town full of garbage, whose inhabitants don't care much of hygiene, living and feeding in the junk. Around 2198, Brotherhood of Steel intelligence located the possible origin of the humanoid robot that attacked Junction City and the tracks originated from Great Bend. The Calculator's robots attacked the place, killed nearly everyone and now were transforming this location into a robot manufacturing facility. Only a few humans survived the initial robot attack on the town: Mike, Noelene, Jake and Gloria. A woman named Ripley, the inhabitant of this town freed from Freeport by the Warrior, could be found dead near the entrance. Eventually, the robots were attacked by the Brotherhood of Steel squad, led by the warrior. A pacification robot, who was damaged by the steel yard cart fallen on him, was found here. General Dekker believed that this robot was the one appointed as a leader, who controlled other robots in this location. With it being damaged the robots become unavailable to complete their task to build a manufacturing plant. It is unknown whether the town was repopulated again.

properties.name: Bunker Alpha
properties.note: In time, the Brotherhood established a harsh rule over the towns and tribal villages in that area, controlled from Bunker Alpha. General Simon Barnaky was stationed here, before moving to Bunker Beta.

properties.name: Jefferson
properties.note: The rubble-strewn city of Jefferson is what remains of Jefferson City, Missouri. One of Gammorin's super mutant staging areas was located there. The mutants had a semi-permanent military base in the ruins of Jefferson.

properties.name: Grand Staircase
properties.note: The Grand Staircase is a remote stretch of land within the Colorado Plateau. It is here that the New Canaanite Daniel wishes to evacuate the Sorrows tribe to, in order to put distance between themselves and the hostile White Legs tribe, who would be unable to follow.

properties.name: Devil's Graveyard
properties.note: Formerly a raider stronghold. After the raiders attacked the village of Dirt Haven, which were allied with the Brotherhood of Steel, the Brotherhood pacified this area by destroying local raider forces.

properties.name: Mardin
properties.note: Mardin is an underground cave labyrinth northwest of St. Louis, within which the lair of the Beastlords was located. The Beastlords possessed an inherent telepathic suggestion which allowed them to control various animals. It was acquired through prolonged exposure to an unknown radiation present within Mardin's underground caves. According to the Brotherhood scribes, this unique mutation only manifests in humans that have been exposed for at least twenty years.

properties.name: Westin Ranch
properties.note: Westin Ranch is a post-war farmstead located directly west of Shady Sands' downtown. In 2241, it is owned by New California Republic Councilman Roger Westin.

properties.name: Greyditch
properties.note: Grayditch is a settlement located in what was formerly Arlington. It was ravaged by fire ants in 2077.

properties.name: Saint Louis
properties.note: The ruins of a once large city, plagued by Super Mutants and raider gangs.

properties.name: Yucca Mountain
properties.note: Yucca Mountain was a pre-war nuclear waste repository. After the Great War, it became abandoned and inhabited by mutated creatures due to the high radioactivity levels.

properties.name: Yosemite Valley
properties.note: Yosemite Valley is a large canyon running through Yosemite National Park. Scavengers that visit it frequently become food for yao guai. ** Yosemite Valley is mentioned in the Royal Flush sourcebook for the Fallout tabletop RPG. **

properties.name: Clouds Rest Mountain
properties.note: ** Mentioned in NPC Pack 4 for the Fallout tabletop RPG. **

properties.name: Mariposa Military Base
properties.note: The Mariposa Military Base was a top-secret United States military facility built to house Forced Evolutionary Virus research previously conducted at West Tek. Used as a staging ground for the Unity, it was destroyed by the Vault Dweller.

properties.name: Scott City
properties.note: Scott City used to be a small community located in rural, far western Kansas. Around 2198 a huge industrial complex was occupied by the Calculator's robots and was used as a prison for captured humans. There, the Calculator conducted his research connected to humans. This place was of a high priority to the robots, as it gave them information about their enemies. It has since been abandoned.

properties.name: Sentinel Site
properties.note: The Sentinel site was a pre-War military facility that was working to make the air-dropped 'Mk. 28' nuclear bombs compatible with a newer ICBM delivery system.

properties.name: Owens Dry Lake
properties.note: Owens Lake was a water reservoir. It had become the staging ground for raiders throughout the Sierra Nevada region, with attacks by them being commonplace until NCR soldiers arrived and drove them out. By 2281, the lake had dried up.

properties.name: The Sacred Bog
properties.note: The sacred bog is a location in Point Lookout, reached via the sacred bog entrance on the westernmost side of the map. It is a winding path through the swamp, populated by various swamp creatures.

properties.name: Macomb
properties.note: Macomb is a town located in the area of the pre-War city of Macomb, Illinois, southwest of Chicago. Around 2197, the Brotherhood of Steel received a distress call from one of their squads acting as an escort to a supply wagon passing through Macomb.

properties.name: Canyon City
properties.note: Canyon City was a pre-war town near the Kansas-Colorado border. It is where the Calculator set up robot repair station 10.92 around 2198, in which damaged robots were mended and parts of destroyed robots were rebuilt and combined to form a whole.

properties.name: Mexico City
properties.note: Mexico City was a pre-war city and the capital of Mexico. In 2042, a major earthquake hit the city, destroying large amounts of it. Afterwards, Mister Handy robots were used to help rebuild, boosting their popularity. The city was hit during the Great War and many residents fled to the surrounding farmlands. Not long after the war, scavengers and raiders started to infest the city and criminal activities became bigger than ever.

properties.name: Space Needle
properties.note: The Space Needle was a pre-war landmark in Seattle, Washington. It was depicted in the 2071 holotape game Atomic Command.

properties.name: Seattle
properties.note: Seattle was a pre-war city.

properties.name: Settlement
properties.note: A small post-war settlement, where Marge LeBarge was born, is located on the shores of Lake LeBarge.

properties.name: Area 51
properties.note: Area 51 is a military base in Nevada and a former testing ground for experimental government aircraft and extraterrestrial phenomena. Area 51 housed some alien technology, including a captured flying saucer which was later re-captured by aliens, but then crashed somewhere in California.

properties.name: Anchorage
properties.note: Anchorage was a pre-war city in Alaska. Between 2066 and 2077, the Chinese occupied it during the Sino-American War.

properties.name: Brotherhood Montana bunker
properties.note: The Brotherhood of Steel established a chapter in Montana prior to 2277, based out of a bunker. It was led by an elder named Patrocolus, whose words were occasionally quoted by Elder Owyn Lyons of the East Coast chapter. ** Depicted location is speculated. **

properties.name: Ghost Farm
properties.note: The Ghost Farm is a small farm on the outskirts of Modoc, created by the Slags just above their main underground settlement. They created a small farm above it at some point prior to 2241. To the people of Modoc, it appeared as if the farm popped up out of nowhere, giving it its name.

properties.name: Outcast outpost
properties.note: The Outcast outpost (or VSS Facility) is a small Brotherhood Outcast compound located in a relatively clean pre-War military bunker. The building itself was under construction, with only the superstructure, elevator, and the VSS Bunker completed.

properties.name: Alaskan Pipeline
properties.note: The Trans-Alaskan Pipeline was an important pre-war oil pipeline cutting through Alaska down into the continental United States. During the Resource Wars, the US established the Anchorage Front Line to protect their pipeline and all of the oil from any outside attack. When the Chinese invaded Alaska in the winter of 2066, the Americans fought back with their new superweapon; power armor, and the Trans-Alaska Pipeline was reclaimed. A section of the pipeline traveled through Canada, and it was the pipelines near sabotage that prompted the military annexation of Canada.

properties.name: Museum of American History / Underworld
properties.note: Underworld is a settlement in the Capital Wasteland in 2277. It was once an exhibit in the Museum of History before the bombs fell. Now it is home to many ostracized non-feral ghouls in Washington, D.C. It is located inside the museum and exists as a small city, complete with a bar, inn, clinic, and general store.

properties.name: Acadia
properties.note: Acadia is a pre-war observatory used by DiMA as a safe haven for synths on the Island in 2287.

properties.name: Fort Independence
properties.note: Fort Independence is the headquarters of the Brotherhood Outcasts in the Capital Wasteland, located west of Fairfax ruins and north of Andale. Upon first arrival, the Brotherhood Outcasts fortifying Fort Independence are being ambushed by raiders from Fairfax ruins.

properties.name: The Nucleus / Mount Desert Island Naval Facility
properties.note: The Nucleus is an old submarine base owned by the United States Navy before the bombs fell. DiMA allowed the Church of the Children of Atom to utilize the place and, in return, protect his old memories from being accessed.

properties.name: Buenos Aires
properties.note: Buenos Aires was a pre-war city in Argentina.

properties.name: Evergreen Mills
properties.note: Evergreen Mills is an old pre-war factory inhabited by a large number of raiders, a few captive slaves, and a super mutant behemoth.

properties.name: National Guard Armory
properties.note: Under the guidance of Ulysses, the White Legs raided the armory and acquired their signature "Storm Drums" guns.

properties.name: Haven
properties.note: Haven is a large pre-war building in the Pitt. It was chosen by Ishmael Ashur to be the headquarters for his raiders while attempting to research a cure to radiation via his infant daughter, Marie, who has a unique immunity to it.

properties.name: The Abbey of the Road
properties.note: The Abbey of the Road is a Christian monastery located somewhere west of the Commonwealth. It sends out missionaries to spread the faith. ** Depicted location is speculated. **

properties.name: Yuma Proving Ground
properties.note: Yuma Proving Ground is a military base mentioned by Lucius to be in Caesar's Legion territory in Arizona. Dale Barton once stopped at the base to salvage a howitzer that he later sold to the Legion.

properties.name: Temple of the Union
properties.note: The Temple of the Union is a small compound of escaped slaves who wish to create a haven to protect and inspire all runaway slaves.

properties.name: Nuka-World transit center
properties.note: The Nuka-World transit center was been a hub for guests of the Nuka-World amusement park. After arriving here, guests could park their cars and use the monorail to get to the park itself.

properties.name: London
properties.note: London was a pre-war city in the United Kingdom.

properties.name: Old Olney
properties.note: Olney is a pre-war town. By 2077, it is derelict and taken over by deathclaws. The Enclave established a basecamp and set up a wide perimeter.

properties.name: Nagasaki
properties.note: Nagasaki was a pre-war city in Japan. In 1945, it was notably the site of the second instance of an atomic bomb being deployed in war.

properties.name: Framingham
properties.note: Framingham was a pre-war town in Massachusetts. During the Great War, it was annihilated.

properties.name: Baltimore
properties.note: Baltimore was a pre-war city in Maryland. After the Great War a cargo ship docked there, due to many of the crew having family in the city, and began raiding to survive.

properties.name: Movie theater
properties.note: A pre-war movie theater was located in Danvers. It became the site of a mass shooting ordered by the Barsconi Crime Family at some point prior to 2077. ** Depicted location is speculated. **

properties.name: Detroit
properties.note: Detroit was a pre-war city in Michigan. Prior to the Great War, it had a notable crime rate, with pipe rifles being commonly used in the streets.

properties.name: Dublin
properties.note: Dublin was a pre-war city in Ireland.

properties.name: Potsdam
properties.note: Potsdam was a pre-war city in Germany. In 1945, US President Harry Truman gave a radio report to the American people on the Potsdam Conference. ** A snippet of the radio report can be heard in Tactics' intro. **

properties.name: Hamburg
properties.note: Hamburg was a pre-war city in Germany. ** The existence of hamburgers in the Fallout universe imply the existence of Hamburg as well, as the former is named after the latter. **

properties.name: Dusseldorf
properties.note: Dusseldorf was a pre-war city in Germany.

properties.name: Edmonton
properties.note: Edmonton was a pre-war Canadian city. Following the United States’ annexation of Canada in 2072, a large-scale riot broke out there, becoming known as the “Uprising of Edmonton”.

properties.name: Jerusalem
properties.note: Jerusalem was a pre-war city in Israel.

properties.name: Springfield
properties.note: Springfield was a pre-war city in Massachusetts. It was where the Type 1861 "Springfield" rifle-musket was created.

properties.name: The Reichstag
properties.note: The Reichstag was a historic pre-war legislative building in Germany.

properties.name: Berlin
properties.note: Berlin was a pre-war city in Germany.

properties.name: Rochester
properties.note: Rochester was a pre-war city in New York. In 2077, an order for 315 tons of stone tables and countertops was shipped there.

properties.name: The White House
properties.note: The White House was a pre-war building in Washington D.C. that housed the President of the United States. During the Great War, a nuclear warhead scored a precise strike on the structure and turned it into a large crater.

properties.name: The Ark & Dove Cathedral
properties.note: Before the Great War, a small community sprung up around the cathedral. Post-war, it is home to a rather devout religious cult who has a tendency to be a refuge for runaway teens.

properties.name: Point Lookout Lighthouse
properties.note: The Point Lookout Lighthouse is a cylindrical structure containing both the main lighthouse facility as well as a secret basement.

properties.name: Pilgrims Landing
properties.note: Pilgrim's Landing is a small tourist attraction inhabited by Panada, Tobar the Ferryman and Nadine. It is the closest thing to actual civilization in Point Lookout.

properties.name: Mount Rushmore
properties.note: Mount Rushmore was a pre-war landmark in South Dakota.

properties.name: Great Lanta (formerly Atlantic City)
properties.note: Atlantic City was a pre-war city in New Jersey, known for its boardwalk and casinos. During the Great War, the city was not hit but instead suffered from immense flooding. At some point, a US military aircraft experiencing engine failure jettisoned its payload of two nuclear bombs into the ocean outside of the city. As a result, the water became extremely irradiated. The incompetent mayor, Carly Day, had not prepared for the chance of war and turned to the local mob, the Lombardi Family, to quell any unrest and manage rations. The mob made the mistake of raiding a farm belonging to Timothy Lane, who killed all but one of the assailants. Angry, he marched to city hall, shot Mayor Day, and took her position for himself. In the following years, Lane managed to turn the city around while maintaining an alliance with both the Lombardis and the Showmen, the latter being a group established to keep the spirit of Old World art and performing alive. Over a century and a half later, the city was known as Great Lanta and had become taken over by slavers. The leader, Ehren, realized the error of his ways, however, and freed them, according to the story of Saint Monica preached onboard Rivet City.

properties.name: Soviet Consulate
properties.note: ** Depicted location is speculated. **

properties.name: Waynesboro
properties.note: Waynesboro was a pre-war town in Pennsylvania. In 2077, an order for 240 tons of stone furniture was shipped there.

properties.name: Tremont
properties.note: Tremont was a pre-war town located on Mount Desert Island. ** Tremont does not physically appear in-game, but is mentioned. **

properties.name: Hidalgo Ranch
properties.note: The Hidalgo Ranch was a pre-war farmstead located outside Mexico City and owned by Raul Tejada’s family. In the days following the Great War, countless refugees passed by the ranch seeking aid, but the sheer number overwhelmed the Tejadas who were forced to turn many of them away. This resulted in a group returning one night and burning down the ranch house, killing the entire family, save Raul and his sister, who managed to escape.

properties.name: New Canaan (formerly Ogden)
properties.note: Ogden was a pre-war city in Utah. Following the Great War, it was resettled by Mormons and became known as New Canaan. Contact was established between it and the New California Republic and the two began trading. In the 23rd century, one New Canaanite, Joshua Graham, left to join Caesar's Legion as the Malpais Legate. He was set on fire and left to die as punishment for his failure to defeat the NCR at the First Battle of Hoover Dam in 2277, but ultimately survived and returned to New Canaan. Word of this reached Caesar himself, who decided the town needed to be destroyed in order to hurt the NCR's trade economy. Caesar sent the frumentarii Ulysses to meet the White Legs tribe. In 2281, it was under this man's guidance that the town was sacked when Graham and other able-bodied men were away. Only around thirty New Canaanites survived, eventually regrouping and migrating to Zion Canyon.

properties.name: Primm
properties.note: Primm is a town south of New Vegas. In September 2281, inmates at an NCR correctional facility up the road broke out, and soon the town was overrun. These "Powder Gangers" as they were known broke off from the main group at the prison and established an impromptu headquarters within the Bison Steve Hotel, after murdering the local sheriff. The west side of the town became occupied by NCR troops in order to stop them from advancing further south.

properties.name: Novac
properties.note: A small pre-war town was located along Highway 95 in Nevada, known for its large T-Rex statue. It survived the Great War and was resettled. Its original name was forgotten and instead became known as Novac, due to these letters being the only ones remaining illuminated on the Dino Dee-lite Motel's "No Vacancy" sign.

properties.name: Long 15 outpost
properties.note: A post-war NCR outpost is located along the Long 15, down the road from the Mojave Outpost. ** Likely equivalent to the town of Baker, as an intersecting overhead freeway can be seen running through it, and Route 127 is said to be the only other way into the Mojave Wasteland from this direction. **

properties.name: University of Arizona
properties.note: The University of Arizona was a pre-war educational institution. At some point in the 23rd century, Caesar’s Legion repurposed the school’s football gear as armor.

properties.name: Phoenix
properties.note: Phoenix is a location mentioned by Joshua Graham. He describes it as "just place, metal and stone".

properties.name: Flagstaff
properties.note: Flagstaff is a pre-war city in Arizona. In 2255, the ruins of the city were taken over by Caesar's Legion, who christened it as their new capital.

properties.name: Bullhead City
properties.note: Bullhead City was once overrun with tribes after the Great War. In 2270, the New California Republic Army showed up in the city to occupy the Mojave area in what it called the "Pacification of the Mojave". Led by General Aaron Kimball, the New California Republic destroyed all the tribes in the Bullhead City area, taking Bullhead under NCR control.

properties.name: Sunnyvale
properties.note: Sunnyvale was a pre-war city in California. Robert House commissioned the development of the platinum chip there, but the Great War erupted a day before it was set to be delivered to him.

properties.name: Oak Creek
properties.note: Oak Creek is a post-war settlement. It was an independent farming town until New California Republic-backed brahmin barons decided they wanted the land. Mercenaries were hired by Senator Morales to harass the town and force the inhabitants to abandon their farms while the barons justified their actions by accusing the townsfolk of being squatters.

properties.name: Sac-Town (formerly Sacramento)
properties.note: Sac-Town, formerly known as Sacramento, was the capital of California before the Great War. By 2281, it was covered by the Short Loop caravan route and was home to the offices of the Happy Trails Caravan Company.

properties.name: Gecko
properties.note: Gecko is a post-war town primarily inhabited by ghouls, founded in 2236. Its economy is based on the operation of an old, half-functional Poseidon Energy nuclear power plant. The settlement is a place where ghouls end up, rather than a destination, as most residents found themselves unwelcome in human habitations. They've also found comfort in the close proximity of the atomic power plant, with some even living inside the reactor building.

properties.name: Modoc
properties.note: Modoc is a small post-war settlement, part of the Big Circle caravan route. For a long time, it traded leather and meat from brahmin, but as other places began offering the same goods at cheaper rates, the town started to decline. By 2241, it was slowly turning into a stop-over point for travelers heading towards Vault City. At some point prior to 2281, Modoc joined the New California Republic and Crimson Caravan opened up a branch there.

properties.name: Crashed Vertibird
properties.note: At some point around 2241, an Enclave vertibird piloted by Daisy Whitman crashed in Klamath Canyon.

properties.name: Klamath Canyon
properties.note: Klamath Canyon is location near Klamath. An Enclave vertibird crashed in it around 2241.

properties.name: Klamath (formerly Klamath Falls)
properties.note: Klamath Falls was a pre-war town located in Oregon. After the Great War, it became simply known as Klamath. In 2241, it was primarily Inhabited by gecko trappers and served as a stopping point for caravans on their way to the tiny tribal villages to the north. Klamath also acted as a hub for said tribals to trade at and gain information about the larger world. ** There is no current information on if Klamath joined the NCR or not. Also, at the moment, this map operates on the assumption that Klamath is based on the Klamath National Forest in California (which it geographically lines up with), not Klamath Falls in Oregon. **

properties.name: Broken Hills
properties.note: Broken Hills was a mining town in the western part of the pre-War state of Nevada. After the war of 2077, it became a haven, inhabited by humans, super mutants and ghouls, living together in relative harmony . Then the uranium ran out. The city, having lost its sole reason for existing, slowly dispersed. The residents carried their riches with them, leaving the place a wind-swept, desolate ghost town. A few hold-outs remained, attempting to eke out a pathetic existence, but eventually, they too, disappeared.

properties.name: Rattletail
properties.note: Rattletail was founded by New California Republic settlers who had moved into Baja, sometime between 2256 and 2261. According to Chief Hanlon, the village was nothing more than six shacks built around a well.

properties.name: Irvine
properties.note: Irvine is a pre-war city in Greater Los Angeles. Following the Great War, it was resettled and eventually annexed by the New California Republic. At some point before 2281, the NCR's 452nd battalion were stationed there.

properties.name: Arroyo
properties.note: Arroyo is a settlement founded in 2167 by the Vault Dweller following his exile from Vault 13 by the overseer. Originally a tribal village, after the Chosen One completed his quest and used the G.E.C.K. in 2242, it would eventually rise in power, becoming a large city and joining the New California Republic. ** Arroyo joined the NCR at some point according to Fallout: The Roleplaying Game, which is said to be canon. **

properties.name: Necropolis (formerly Bakersfield)
properties.note: Bakersfield was a city located in California that was hit hard during the Great War. Its remains eventually became known as Necropolis, or the City of the Dead, and was inhabited by ghouls.

properties.name: Scrapheap
properties.note: Scrapheap is a small, post-war town located near Junktown and Necropolis. The sole reason for its existence is a power generator that runs on brahmin excrement. In 2161 it was dominated by a gang called the Crypts that controlled the power generator and therefore ruled over the small community. The leader of the Crypts was a man named Rayze. Their rival gang, the Fools, was led by a woman named Baka. She proclaimed herself to be the "Queen" of the gang. ** Depicted location is speculated. **

properties.name: Junktown
properties.note: Junktown is a post-war settlement created entirely out of scrap. By 2161, general store owner Killian Darkwater served as mayor, often clashing with local casino owner Gizmo.

properties.name: Circle Junction
properties.note: Circle Junction was an abandoned pre-war train depot. The Iron Rivers tribals were lead to it by following the path of a "great roaring machine that disappeared". In 2253, it was surrounded and attacked by Caesar's Legion. Most of the tribals were killed or captured, but the ones that survived soon fled southeast, to their former hunting grounds.

properties.name: Two-Sun (formerly Tuscon)
properties.note: Tucson was a pre-war city in Arizona. After the Great War, it became known as Two-Sun and was home to Raul Tejada for 75 years. It was constantly harassed by raiders until the arrival of Caesar’s Legion at some point after 2248, who pacified the area.

properties.name: Malpais
properties.note: Malpais is a settlement located somewhere in Legion territory. It is mentioned by Corporal Sterling during dialogue about his capture by Caesar's Legion.

properties.name: Sloan
properties.note: Sloan is a small pre-war community located along Interstate 15. In the 23rd century, it is inhabited by New California Republic-employed miners who work at Quarry Junction.

properties.name: Quarry Junction
properties.note: Quarry Junction is a pre-war limestone quarry. In the 23rd century, it was taken over by the New California Republic in order to help make concrete, primarily for fortifications in the ongoing war against Caesar's Legion. In 2281, a pack of deathclaws moved into the quarry, forcing operations to halt. Mining would ultimately never resume, and by 2296, the deathclaws made their way to the New Vegas Strip.

properties.name: HELIOS One
properties.note: HELIOS One is a pre-war solar power plant owned by Poseidon Energy, that also doubled as a weapons development laboratory. Under supervision of the US military, ARCHIMEDES I - a laser defense system - and ARCHIMEDES II - an orbital bombardment platform - were created there. Post-war, the facility came to be controlled by the Brotherhood of Steel until their loss to the NCR during Operation: Sunburst, who in-turn took over the complex.

properties.name: Cheyenne Mountain
properties.note: During the 20th century, the American military created a facility underneath Cheyenne Mountain, one mountain in a range of many on the western side of the United States. These ranges extended from Canada, far to the north past the United States border, down into the southeast of the country. Vault 0 is located here, housing the Calculator.

properties.name: Lost Hills bunker
properties.note: The Lost Hills bunker is a pre-war government bunker and the headquarters of the Brotherhood of Steel. Mysterious and impenetrable, it is the subject of myths and legends among many wastelanders.

properties.name: Abbey of Lost Knowledge
properties.note: The Abbey of Lost Knowledge is a monastery located north of Gecko, in which monks preserved technical knowledge in the form of books, blueprints and items. Interestingly, the monks did not actually understand the technical knowledge in the books they preserved in any practical sense. Instead, they treated them like holy materials; they were read, copied and cared for, but none of the knowledge was used as originally intended. Although not a single preserved item at the Abbey functioned, it was open to anyone as long as they did not damage anything. ** Despite being cut from Fallout 2, mentions of it in source materials exist. **

properties.name: Saugus Ironworks
properties.note: Saugus is a large ironworks facility formally controled by a gang of raiders known as the Forged

properties.name: Dunwich Borers
properties.note: A large, functioning mine with ties to the occult, controlled by the Forged after the Great War.

properties.name: Project Purity (formerly the Jefferson Memorial)
properties.note: In the 2250s, the Memorial was selected by project lead James for Project Purity, primarily due to its location. The project's stated aim was for converting the Memorial into a water purifier where the river's water could be cleansed of radiation for use by residents of the Capital Wasteland. Project Purity was abandoned after James' wife Catherine died giving birth to their child, and then picked up again 20 years later.

properties.name: Buena Vista
properties.note: Buena Vista was a pre-War city in Colorado. Around 2198, Brotherhood of Steel reconnaissance had found an operating nuclear reactor located on the outskirts of the town. The reactor was supplying a vast majority of the power for the Calculator's robot army, as well as powering the nearby robot factories. The Facility was destroyed by the Brotherhood.

properties.name: Fort Abandon (formerly Fort Aradesh)
properties.note: Fort Abandon is a rundown New California Republic fort located east of the Big Circle. It was originally called Fort Aradesh, and was a major fortification until it was vacated. Eventually, the fort came to be known as Fort Abandon. ** Depicted location is speculated. **

properties.name: Atom Cats garage (formerly Red Rocket filling station)
Camp Willow
properties.note: It is known that there was an NCR military camp within Willow Beach. However, some time after the First Battle of Hoover Dam the Battle of Willow Beach took place. As a result the camp was destroyed. This later led to NCR being pushed off of the east side of the Colorado River.

properties.name: Area 2
properties.note: Area 2 was a pre-war weapons depot. At some point in the 23rd century, a tribe known as the Boomers sent an expedition to the base to gather weapons.

properties.name: Turtledove Detention Camp
properties.note: Turtledove Detention Camp is a pre-war military prison. Multiple captured Chinese spies were brought to it for interrogation.

properties.name: Raven Rock
properties.note: Raven Rock (known as Site R before the Great War), is the Enclave's main base of operations in the Capital Wasteland. After the Lone Wanderer is captured in 2277, a civil war breaks out in Raven Rock between President John Henry Eden's robots and Colonel Augustus Autumn and the Enclave troopers. Raven Rock is eventually either destroyed by Liberty Prime during the two weeks after the activation of Project Purity, if the Lone Wanderer didn't previously cause it to self destruct.

properties.name: Girdershade
properties.note: Girdershade is a tiny post-war settlement built under an old freeway viaduct. It is home to only two long-term residents: Sierra Petrovita, the town's founder, and Ronald Laren, who occupied a second house after its original occupants were slain.

properties.name: Tel Aviv
properties.note: Tel Aviv was a pre-war city in Israel. In 2053, terrorists detonated a nuke within the city, destroying it.

properties.name: Antioch
properties.note: Antioch is a location where the Holy Hand Grenade was created. In 2241, it was sought by Brotherhood of Steel member Arthur Pendragon. ** This was all made as a reference to Monty Python and the Holy Grail. **

properties.name: Madrid
properties.note: Madrid was a pre-war city in Spain.

properties.name: Monterey
properties.note: Monterey was a pre-war city in California. The National Aquatic Protection Symposium was set to be held there during the last week of October in 2077.

properties.name: Calverton
properties.note: Calverton was a pre-war town. In 2077, the only building left is its chapel. ** In the game, Calverton is located more-so around Evergreen Mills. **

properties.name: Meresti
properties.note: Meresti was a pre-war city in Romania. Its name inspired the name of Meresti Station in the Washington D.C. metro area.

properties.name: Juneau
properties.note: Juneau was a pre-war city. It served as the state capital of Alaska.

properties.name: Lisbon
properties.note: Lisbon was a pre-war city in Portugal.

properties.name: Little Rock
properties.note: Little Rock was a pre-war city in Arkansas.

properties.name: Versailles
properties.note: Versailles was a pre-war city in France.

properties.name: Paris
properties.note: Paris was a pre-war city in France.

properties.name: Penticton
properties.note: Penticton was a pre-war city in Canada. Dane, one of the insane members of the Children of the Cathedral, claims he may have lived there at some point, or at the very least saw it on a map.

properties.name: Petersburg
properties.note: Petersburg was a pre-war city in Virginia. In 2077, an order for 275 tons of stone slabs was shipped there.

properties.name: Portland
properties.note: Portland was a pre-war city in Maine. A military briefing was held there at some point before 2077.

properties.name: Rockville
properties.note: Rockville was a pre-war town in Maryland. On the day of the Great War, an order for 108 tons of stone obelisks was set to be shipped there.

properties.name: Rome
properties.note: Rome was a pre-war city in Italy.

properties.name: Ancient city
properties.note: A city from a long-gone civilization is buried beneath the Rub' al Khali desert in Arabia. Lorenzo Cabot, believing it to be the lost city of Ubar, traveled there in 1894 to uncover it. Upon placing an ancient artifact on his head, he learned the city was not Ubar, and proceeded to slowly fall into insanity.

properties.name: Suez
properties.note: Suez was a pre-war city in Egypt. In 1894, it was briefly visited by Lorenzo Cabot while traveling to Oman to begin his search for the lost city of Ubar.

properties.name: Tokyo
properties.note: Tokyo was a pre-war city in Japan.

properties.name: Anaheim
properties.note: Anaheim was a pre-war city in Greater Los Angeles. Their football team, the Anaheim Jets, was said to have won Super Bowl CXII in 2075.

properties.name: Brotherhood outpost
properties.note: ** Depicted location is speculated. **

properties.name: Kronach
properties.note: Kronach was a pre-war city in Germany. It was the hometown of Vault 112 Overseer Dr. Stanislaus Braun.

properties.name: 4 Charter Street
properties.note: 4 Charter Street was a pre-war garage owned by criminal Vinnie "The Crackers" Vannucci. ** Mentioned in one of Eddie Winter's holotapes. In-game, the subtitles list it as "4 Prince Street". **

properties.name: Boulder City Memorial
properties.note: "What the fuck are you doing?!"

properties.name: Swan's Pond
properties.note: Originally part of the separate Public Garden, Swan's Pond was built in the pre-war Boston Common when the city sold the former's land for development. Further reduction of the Common resulted in the pond shrinking so much to the point that the rental swan boats kept bumping into each other.

properties.name: Boston Common
properties.note: Boston Common started out as a grazing ground for cattle until it eventually became a pre-war city park. In the 21st century, the city merged it with the Public Garden and began selling off parts of the land for development, vastly reducing its size. ** The Common in-universe is vastly smaller than its real-life counterpart due to game limitations. The story of the city selling off the land is a clever attempt by the developers to give a lore reason for the size. **

properties.name: Cabot House
properties.note: ** In-game, Cabot House is located more to the northeast, by the expressway. **

properties.name: The Squat
properties.note: The Squat is a grouping of tents and small buildings up against the side of a cliff.

properties.name: One Pine
properties.note: Lone Pine was a pre-war city. Following the Great War, it became known as One Pine and joined the New California Republic at some point before 2281. Private First Class Jeremy Watson was born there.

properties.name: Caliente
properties.note: Caliente is a small town along Highway 93. It has a stable source of fresh water and a geothermal power station, making it a popular target for raiders, typically White Legs or the 80s.

properties.name: The Citadel (formerly the Pentagon)
properties.note: The Citadel is the heavily defended headquarters of the Brotherhood of Steel in the Capital Wasteland in 2277. It is built into and beneath the ruins of the Pentagon, the pre-war headquarters of the U.S. military.

properties.name: Rivet City
properties.note: Rivet City is a city located inside a decaying, beached aircraft carrier in Washington, D.C. It's the largest, most developed and scientifically-advanced settlement in the Capital Wasteland. Its inhabitants live in individual rooms and enjoy safety and security inside the aircraft carrier. A number of guards rotate 24 hours a day to protect the ship from raiders, super mutants, mirelurks and any other threats to the city and its inhabitants. Rivet City includes a shopping area, as well as an American history museum, science lab, church, clinic, bar, and even a hotel.

properties.name: Megaton
properties.note: Megaton is a fortified settlement in the Capital Wasteland. It began as a group of people sheltering in a crater containing an undetonated atomic bomb during the aftermath of the Great War. Eventually, it became a full-fledged trading center, and walls were built out of pre-war airplanes to defend against raider attacks. In 2277, the town was by proxy under the protection of the Regulators, as one of their members, Lucas Simms, served as the sheriff and de facto mayor.

properties.name: Big Town
properties.note: Big Town is a medium sized settlement surrounded by a makeshift wall. The town consists of six survivors and four possible additional characters. The town has been ravaged by super mutant and slaver attacks.

properties.name: Arefu
properties.note: Arefu is a small Capital Wasteland settlement consisting of four houses, located on top of a crumbling overpass bridge.

properties.name: Tenpenny Tower
properties.note: Tenpenny Tower is a pre-war luxury hotel built over an old plantation. Following the Great War, it was taken over by aristocrat Allistair Tenpenny, who turned the tower into a luxury apartment and commercial building. Only the well-to-do or wealthy are permitted to reside there. By 2277, a group of ghouls, led by Roy Phillips, desire to live in the building as well and have made repeated attempts to gain entrance.

properties.name: Little Lamplight
properties.note: Little Lamplight is a pre-War underground cavern tourist attraction made into a settlement in the Capital Wasteland, run and populated entirely by children under the age of 16.

properties.name: Mason District
properties.note: ** In-game, the Mason District is located much closer to the Potomac River. **

properties.name: Andale
properties.note: Andale is touted by its residents as "the greatest town in Virginia". However, the town holds a very dark secret. Four families survived the nuclear war and remained in Andale, but eventually took to cannibalism after their food supplies ran out. Since then, the murder and consumption of outsiders, along with inbreeding between the Andale families, have become a tradition that's been passed down from generation to generation.

properties.name: Philly
properties.note: The city lies in ruins, but one piece of American history still stands there, the Liberty Bell. Philly is mentioned in Abraham Washington's terminal. It states that he ran into a traveler from there, and that he has funded an expedition to retrieve the Liberty Bell.

properties.name: Canterbury Commons
properties.note: Canterbury Commons is a small town and trading post located on the eastern edge of the Capital Wasteland. It was initially founded by Uncle Roe and his sister Daisy as a trading center for caravan merchants.

properties.name: Adams AFB
properties.note: Adams Air Force Base is a heavily-fortified Enclave compound outside the Capital Wasteland in Maryland. After the Battle of Adams Air Force Base, the Brotherhood of Steel occupy the base.

properties.name: The Pitt (formerly Pittsburgh)
properties.note: The Pitt, formerly Pittsburgh, is a pre-war city in Pennsylvania, known for its steel industry. It was hit during the Great War, and the resulting radiation mixed with the steel mills’ pollution to create the Troglodyte Degeneration Contagion. By 2127, the city had become split between warring gangs and criminals, which lasted until the Brotherhood of Steel’s arrival in 2255. The Brotherhood killed nearly half of the population, clearing out the most violent inhabitants, while believing to have lost only one of the own during the fighting: Initiate Ishmael Ashur. In actuality, he survived and was left behind. Over the next 22 years, Ashur formed a group of raiders and took control of the city. He began using slave labor to help rebuild it, while simultaneously attempting to discover a cure for the radiation through his infant daughter, Marie, who possesses a unique immunity to it.

properties.name: Monroeville
properties.note: Monroeville is a pre-war town near Pittsburgh. In 2277, one of Ishmael Ashur's raiders, Everett, claims it is affected by the Troglodyte Degeneration Contagion and has a ghoul population.

properties.name: Shady Sands
properties.note: Shady Sands was a post-war settlement in the New California region, founded by a group of settlers from Vault 15 in 2141. The settlement was jump-started using the vault's G.E.C.K., allowing for rudimentary agriculture and the construction of adobe buildings from sandcrete. In 2186, Shady Sands was the birthplace of the New California Republic, which the town soon colloquially became known as. For nearly a hundred years, the settlement served as the nation's capital. In 2277, however, a pivotal chain of events occurred, later chronicled as the "Fall of Shady Sands", culminating in its destruction in 2283. Vault 33 overseer Hank MacLean, following Vault-Tec's mandate to erase all factionalism from the wasteland, sent a brain-controlled soldier wheeling an atomic bomb into the town on a cart. The warhead promptly detonated, creating a massive crater. The wreckage was explored shortly after by the Knights of San Fernando Brotherhood of Steel chapter, where they rescued a young boy named Maximus, who survived the explosion inside a refrigerator. ** Note from creator: The first two Fallout games place Shady Sands roughly in between Vaults 13 and 15, but the TV show puts it in the northern Boneyard. This discrepancy has yet to be addressed by the showrunners. I am choosing to leave it where it was originally, until new info emerges. **

properties.name: Crater of Atom
properties.note: A massive detonation crater southwest of Boston, it was ground zero for the high-yield nuclear explosion which devastated Massachusetts and created the Glowing Sea. The Crater of Atom hosts humans from the Church of the Children of Atom, who treat the location as a holy site and seem inexplicably immune to its deadly radiation.

properties.name: Long Branch Arsenal
properties.note: The Long Branch Arsenal was a pre-war factory. Following the United States’ annexation of Canada in 2072, firearms made there were issued to US servicemen.

properties.name: Ronto (formerly Toronto)
properties.note: Ronto is a post-war location. It has significant military power around 2277 and is implied to be targeted by raiders in control of the Pitt when acquiring new slaves.

properties.name: Chicago
properties.note: Chicago was a city located in Illinois. It was nearly completely destroyed in the Great War and the few that survived the bombs now live mostly in small tribal villages near the former city. Some time after the defeat of the Master in 2162, the Brotherhood of Steel constructed airships and dispatched some of its soldiers East, to track down and assess the extent of the remaining super mutant threat. They a new Brotherhood of Steel chapter, which diverged greatly from the ideals of the main one. In time, they established a harsh rule over the towns and villages near Chicago, controlled from Bunker Alpha. The sky over the city is always dark and stormy, and the ruins are completely deserted.

properties.name: Brahmin Wood
properties.note: Brahmin Wood is a resource-rich tribal village in the area of the pre-War city of Chicago, Illinois. In 2197, it was invaded by a group of raiders led by Horus. Brahmin Wood's losses were heavy, and they decided to accept the Brotherhood of Steel's conditions for protection. After the Brotherhood drove away and killed the raiders and bandits, the tribals from Brahmin Wood eventually became the largest contributor of manpower to the Brotherhood's war machine.

properties.name: Springfield
properties.note: Springfield is a town in Illinois, near the Brotherhood of Steel Bunker Beta. Its population consists mostly of humans with some ghouls. After the previous mayor disappeared under suspicious circumstances, Avellone was voted in as a puppet mayor. But he took to his new power and started causing trouble. The mayor's political stance with the ghouls angered some of Springfield's far-right, human activists who refuse to acknowledge the "sub-humans" as near equals, so the plot against ghouls and the mayor was started. Normally, the Brotherhood doesn't meddle in politics, but this offered them a chance to increase their hold on this resource rich province and the Elders decided to send a Brotherhood squad to Springfield to protect Avellone from a plot uncovered by the Brotherhood's Dagger Squad, who captured one of the ringleaders to this plot. He told the Brotherhood interrogators that these resident troublemakers would be dressed as raiders, which was a clumsy attempt to frame the local bandits. The Warrior soon arrived and liberated the town from occupation. These ghoul-hating "raiders" turned out to be quite an organized group consisting of regular members and so called enforcers - much more experienced warriors. Even though they awaited the Brotherhood's arrival and had already build some barricades, they were all killed, including their leader - the head assassin. After the BoS squad rescued the mayor, the resources of Springfield helped fuel the Brotherhood war machine. He signed the "Bill of Monster Rights". Under this bill, there would be no violence against a ghoul...unless the ghoul started it. And from now on, a ghoul was entitled to payment equal to, or greater than, half that of a pure bred human. And lastly, no more would "taking a dump" be referred to as "pinching the ghoul", "making ghoul babies" or "dropping off the ghoul at the pool".

properties.name: Junction City
properties.note: Junction City is a mid sized town in Kansas that refused to form an alliance with the Brotherhood of Steel. Their independent posture was reinforced by their victory over one of the Calculator's humanoid robots.

properties.name: Cold Water
properties.note: Cold Water is a town built amongst the ruins of the pre-War city of Coldwater, Kansas. Cold Water is mainly famous in the region for its casino, and is inhabited by mostly humans, as well as a few ghouls.

properties.name: Carbon
properties.note: Carbon is a small community of farmers and breeders of brahmin. It is governed by a mayor named Richard until deposed by the Initiate and replaced with Vidya. Carbon is located right next to a large crater that was caused by the Great War and half of the town fell into it. While the town itself is split into east, west, north, and central, the town center is the only part the player can access when not involved in a quest. The Brotherhood of Steel sent an Initiate to Carbon on his first mission, to find and assist several Brotherhood paladins believed to be in the town.

properties.name: Hopeville
properties.note: Hopeville was a pre-war city established in the late 21st century to be an example of the American Dream.

properties.name: Big MT / The Big Empty
properties.note: The Big Mountain Research and Development Center, alternately known as Big MT or the Big Empty, was a privately owned pre-war defense contractor and research center.

properties.name: Newton / Junk City
properties.note: Newton or Junk City was the main camp of the Reaver Movement, a technology-worshiping cult.

properties.name: Dirt Haven
properties.note: Dirt Haven is a small tribal village in the area of the pre-War city of Chicago, Illinois. During their initial recruitment drives, the Brotherhood of Steel formed an alliance with the village. The Brotherhood provides them with protection from bandits and raiders and they in turn, supply them with food and their most able bodied young as recruits.

properties.name: Freeport
properties.note: Before the war, it was a moderately sized city in the state of llinois. By 2197, the town had become a rather large raider den, housing limited supplies of fossil fuels and a large alcohol distillery.

properties.name: Peoria
properties.note: The tribal village of Peoria is now only a mockery of the once big city of Peoria, Illinois, located halfway between Chicago and St. Louis. After the Great War, only a small, primitive village was living here. They built their homes over a pre-War storehouse of fusion batteries, which they believe was a gateway between life and death. While the Whachutu tribals knew about the batteries, they did not understand their function. The storehouse was guarded by automated turrets and inhabited by radscorpions and giant cockroaches (considered to be "evil spirits" by the tribals).

properties.name: Quincy
properties.note: Quincy is what remains of the pre-War Quincy, Illinois, known as the Gem City.The town is home to both humans and ghouls, which sometimes leads to racial tensions. The ghoul population of Quincy live in a district called Shanty Town which lies on the western side of the tracks that run the length of the town. They have made the abandoned rail facilities their home. Around 2197, the township of Quincy asked the Brotherhood of Steel for protection from a large group of tribals called the Beastlords.

properties.name: Bunker Gamma
properties.note: After the Brotherhood defeated the psychic Beastlords, they moved south to this bunker to establish a secure area of operations.

properties.name: The Hub
properties.note: The Hub is a major trading center and settlement, built within an old town mostly untouched by the Great War. It eventually joined the New California Republic as one of its founding states in 2189.

properties.name: Dayglow (formerly San Diego)
properties.note: Dayglow, originally known as San Diego, is a city near the site of the Glow (from which its name is partially derived) and located in southern California. In 2189, Dayglow became one of the five founding states within the NCR. The Dayglow Incorporation Address by NCR President Tandi is represented on the NCR $100 bill.

properties.name: Camp Navarro
properties.note: Before the War, Navarro served as a Poseidon Oil refinery. Adjacent to the oil installations, a government-funded military base was constructed, together with a satellite up-link station, as well as maintenance and repair facilities.

properties.name: Anza-Borrego
properties.note: Anza-Borrego is town located near the NCR state of Dayglow. The inhabitants of Rattletail were convinced to resettle to Anza-Borrego by Chief Hanlon after they were killing wastelanders they thought were raiders stealing their water. They had difficulties at first, but later found a living raising bighorners.

properties.name: Camp McCarran (formerly McCarran International Airport)
properties.note: McCarran International Airport was a pre-war airport in Las Vegas. After the Great War, in the 23rd century, following the New Vegas Treaty, the NCR was allowed by Robert House to establish a military base there, known as Camp McCarran.

properties.name: Enclave Oil Rig
properties.note: The Enclave Oil Rig, officially Control Station ENCLAVE, was the headquarters of the Enclave until 2242, when it was destroyed.

properties.name: Paradise Falls
properties.note: Paradise Falls is a converted strip style shopping mall turned slaver haven in the Capital Wasteland, with business ties to further slave trade in The Pitt. It is a constant source of fear for many of the wasteland denizens.

properties.name: Chinatown / Shi Town
properties.note: (Also called Shi-town) is a location in San Francisco. Once a suburb of the great city, it has been adopted by the descendants of the Shi-huang-ti crew, who have lived in the red brick houses ever since. In 2241, it's the heart of the city and a focal point for Shi internal struggles.

properties.name: The Glow (formerly the West Tek Research Facility)
properties.note: The West Tek Research Facility, later known as the Glow, the Great Glow, or the Hot Spot, was founded in 2002 as the primary research installation for West Tek. During the Great War in 2077, it was directly hit by a nuclear weapon, turning it into a large, extremely radioactive hole in the ground. As a result, "the Glow" often became a substitute for the word "hell" in Wasteland terminology.

properties.name: Toxic caves
properties.note: The toxic caves are a cave system near Arroyo. Prior to the Great War, it was used as a military warehouse. By 2241, it became radioactive and filled with geckos.

properties.name: Bunker Delta
properties.note: After Gammorin's super mutants were defeated, this new bunker was taken by the Brotherhood, to firmly establish a secure area of operations. After the Reaver cult was mostly destroyed by both the Brotherhood and the Calculator's robots, the command center was moved to Bunker Epsilon.

properties.name: Bonnie Springs
properties.note: Bonnie Springs is a pre-war city in Nevada. It was abandoned at some point following the Great War, eventually becoming occupied by the Jackals gang prior to 2281.

properties.name: Old Mormon Fort
properties.note: Old Mormon Fort is the oldest building in New Vegas. By 2281, it had become a regional headquarters of the Followers of the Apocalypse.

properties.name: Ranger Station Charlie (formerly Shady Pines Trailer Park)
Camp Golf (formerly the House Resort and Country Club)
Sierra Madre
properties.note: Sierra Madre is a planned pre-war city, consisting of a villa and a large casino. Knowing nuclear was on the horizon, its financer Fredrick Sinclair chose a remote location near the Grand Canyon and designed the casino to be a fortress in order to save himself and his love, actress Vera Keys. He made a deal with the Big MT Research Facility to supply the city with experimental holographic security and matter recombinating vending machines, but without his knowledge, they opted to use the Sierra Madre as the testing ground for an airborne toxin. Sinclair learned that Keys and the lounge singer Dean Domino were secretly plotting to steal gold stored within the casino's vault, and modified it to trap them. However, Vera broke down and confessed to Sinclair, who felt remorse and decided to disable the trap, but succumbed to the toxin before he could do so. The Great War occurred shortly after, and the holographic security mistook the casino guests for intruders, slaughtering them, including Vera. Though ghoulified, Domino survived and still sought the gold, spending the next 200 years plotting and mapping out the casino and its extensive security, while the toxin enveloped the city and surrounding land in a massive cloud.

properties.name: Silver Rush
properties.note: The Silver Rush Gambling Hall was a pre-war casino located along Fremont Street. Following the Great War, it continued to operate as a casino until its owners ran afoul of the Van Graff family. At some point prior to 2281, the Van Graffs took over the building, got rid of the gambling hardware, and opened up a storefront for their energy weapons business.

properties.name: King's School of Impersonation
properties.note: The King's School of Impersonation was a pre-war businesses that taught how to impersonate Elvis Presley. In the late 23rd century, it was taken over by a gang who mistook the building as having been a place of worship. Inspired, they named themselves "the Kings".

properties.name: Vikki and Vance Casino and Museum
Clark Field
properties.note: Clark Field was a pre-war power plant and nuclear storage site. It was struck by bombs during the Great War, causing large amounts of radiation to begin seeping out.

properties.name: Fortress
properties.note: The Fortress is a reinforced storage facility located in the eastern part of the Boneyard. After the war, it came to be occupied by the Gun Runners, who use it to store their wares.

properties.name: Bunker 13 / Abandoned BoS bunker
properties.note: Bunker 13, also known as the abandoned BoS bunker, is an underground bunker in the Mojave Wasteland. It was used by the Mojave chapter of the Brotherhood of Steel until their defeat to the NCR at HELIOS One during Operation: Sunburst in 2276. Afterwards, it was abandoned for several years until Father Elijah, the Mojave Brotherhood’s former leader, began using it as a residence and laboratory.

properties.name: Michael Angelo's Sign Shop
properties.note: A pre-war H&H Tools Company facility was located along Las Vegas Boulevard. Nearly 200 years after the Great War in 2077, Sheldon Weintraub, a former resident of the nearby Vault 21, took up residence within and established Michael Angelo's Sign Shop, which provides billboards, signs, and lights to the casinos in New Vegas.

properties.name: Damascus
properties.note: Damascus was a pre-war town in Maryland. In 2077, an order for 250 tons of stone pillars was shipped there.

properties.name: Emergency service railyard
properties.note: The emergency service railyard is a pre-war location north of Nipton. As of 2281, it sits unused.

properties.name: Ipswich
properties.note: Ipswich was a pre-war city in the United Kingdom.

properties.name: Altoona
properties.note: Altoona was a town in the state of Pennsylvania. In the aftermath of the Great War, former professional basketball players Nathan Broadhurst and Jim Walker passed through it while traveling with a survivor group, where the two then split off to head down towards Appalachia.

properties.name: Bedford
properties.note: Bedford is a pre-war town in Pennsylvania. Not long after the Great War occurred, a group of survivors built fortifications and began aggressively patrolling the area on bikes. Former professional baseball players Jim Walker and Nathan Broadhurst passed through the town while heading towards Appalachia and were captured. They managed to escape, but Walker was killed in the process.

properties.name: Galax
properties.note: Galax is a pre-war town. At some point after 2077, it was deserted.

properties.name: Beckley
properties.note: ** Located much farther west in-game. **

properties.name: Coos Bay
properties.note: Coos Bay was a town in Oregon that suffered from mass flooding after the Great War.

properties.name: Albuquerque
properties.note: Albuquerque was a pre-war city in New Mexico.

properties.name: El Paso
properties.note: El Paso was a pre-war city in Texas. In 2072, it was the site of a carjacking committed by "Shanghai Sally".

properties.name: Galveston
properties.note: Galveston was a pre-war city in Texas. In 2072, it was the site of a boat theft committed by "Shanghai Sally".

properties.name: Austin
properties.note: Austin was a pre-war city that served as the capital of Texas. It was home to Red Raptor Firearms.

properties.name: Revere
properties.note: Revere was a pre-war municipality. ** Revere's existence is implied via the Revere satellite array. **

properties.name: Galway Bay
properties.note: Galway Bay is a body of water in Ireland. At some point prior to the Great War, mob boss Eddie Winter suggested to his girlfriend that they visit the bay while on vacation.

properties.name: Waterford
properties.note: Waterford was a pre-war city in Ireland.

properties.name: Kilkenny
properties.note: Kilkenny was a pre-war city in Ireland.

properties.name: Hiroshima
properties.note: Hiroshima was a pre-war city in Japan. In 1945, it was notably the site of the first instance of an atomic bomb being deployed in war.

properties.name: Parker's Restaurant and Fountain
properties.note: Parker's Restaurant and Fountain was a pre-war business in Las Vegas. By 2281, the building is boarded up and vacant.

properties.name: Nipton
properties.note: Nipton was a small town in the Mojave Wasteland with a seedy reputation. In 2281, the mayor, Joseph B. Steyn, was propositioned by Vulpes Inculta, a member of Caesar's Legion, to allow the capture of a group of Powder Gangers and a group of NCR soldiers within the town in exchange for 8,000 caps. Steyn agreed, but was soon betrayed by the Legion, who rounded up himself the townsfolk as well. They held a lottery, in which the participants' fates were decided based on their ticket. The mayor was thrown onto a pile of burning tires, the "lucky losers" as they were called were decapitated, many were crucified, and some were enslaved. Only two were set free: the runner-up, a Powder Ganger named Boxcars whose punishment was simply broken legs, and the winner, another Powder Ganger named Oliver Swanick who was left unharmed.

properties.name: Red Square
properties.note: Red Square was a massive pre-war urban square outside of the Kremlin in Moscow.

properties.name: The Kremlin
properties.note: The Kremlin was a fortified pre-war complex serving as the Soviet Union’s capitol building.

properties.name: Moscow
properties.note: Moscow was a pre-war city in Russia.

properties.name: Airport
properties.note: The walls of Megaton were constructed from scrap found at a pre-war airport a few miles away. By 2277, it was said that virtually no trace of the airport remained.

properties.name: Cheyenne
properties.note: Cheyenne was a pre-war city in Wyoming, serving as the state capital. Goodsprings resident Sunny Smiles named her dog after it.

properties.name: Memory Den (formerly the Scollay Square Theater)
The Slog (formerly the Middlesex County public swimming pool)
Banfield College
properties.note: Banfield College was a pre-war college in Humboldt, Oregon. In 2041, Professor Morrison Rand was abducted from it by the Zetans.

properties.name: Humboldt
properties.note: Humboldt was a pre-war town in Oregon.

properties.name: Salalah
properties.note: Salalah was a pre-war city in Oman. In 1894, it was briefly visited by Lorenzo Cabot while traveling through the country to begin his search for the lost city of Ubar.

properties.name: Ranger safe house
properties.note: The NCR Rangers maintain a series of safe houses in the northern regions of New California. They were primarily used in the 2240s when NCR authority did not stretch as far. ** Note from creator: While these safe houses do not appear in game, they are mentioned to exist in Fallout 2. In 2065, a nuclear reactor, struggling to power the population of seventeen million people, went super critical for a period of about five minutes. While there was no explosion, the NYC incident coined the term "hot summer" for a heat-related electrical overload on nuclear systems. During the Great War, the city was hit. properties.note: The Bellagio is a pre-war casino in Las Vegas. Despite multiple casinos reopening following Robert House's takeover of the Strip in 2274, the Bellagio was not among them. Signs advertising the casino still remain intact and visible in 2296.

properties.name: Antioch
properties.note: Antioch was an old Greek city during the Byzantine period. A pre-war city in California took its name after it.

properties.name: Solvag
properties.note: Solvag was a pre-war city in California. It was home to Vault-Tec employee Betty Pearson. ** The mis-spelling is due to the Fallout TV show's subtitles. **

properties.name: Denver
properties.note: Denver was a pre-war city in Colorado. After the Great War, it became overrun with feral dogs. Eventually, the outskirts became inhabited by a tribe called the Hangdogs, who worshipped the animals and treated them as their companions. The city was eventually conquered by Caesar's Legion, who assimilated the Hangdogs. ** The name Dog Town or Dog City only appears to have been part of Van Buren, and is yet to be made canon. **

properties.name: The Hole
properties.note: The Hole is a struggling bar in the Den. The owner, Frankie, blames Becky's Casino Bar for the lack of business, as the liquor there is sold cheaper.

properties.name: San Francisco
properties.note: San Francisco is a city in Northern California. After the Great War, its population consists mostly of the Shi, who are the descendants of the crew of a Chinese submarine that crashed there, and the members of a religious cult known as the Hubologists.

properties.name: The Den
properties.note: The Den is a post-war town. In 2241, it had no central authority or any law enforcement, leading to a Darwinian struggle where only the strong survived. The town's economy relied heavily on the drug and slave trade. Eventually, the town was annexed by the New California Republic. By 2281, its economy is now based in manufacturing and farming.

properties.name: W&M Law School
properties.note: The W&M Law School was a pre-war law school. One of its attendees, Eileen Suh, was buried in Golgotha outside of New Reno.

properties.name: Rolling Hills Estates
properties.note: Rolling Hills Estates is a pre-war planned community somewhere in the Reno area. In 2241, billboards advertising it are still visible.

properties.name: Hidden Valley Country Club
properties.note: The Hidden Valley Country Club is a pre-war golf club. Following the Great War, a super mutant set up several traps around it and took up residence there with his mutant hounds. Eventually, he was accidentally killed by one of his own traps and his hounds overran the golf course. In the 23rd century, a raider attempted to discover a hidden cache within it, documenting his efforts in a journal. ** The Hidden Valley Country Club is mentioned in the Royal Flush sourcebook for the Fallout tabletop RPG. **

properties.name: Hidden Valley
properties.note: Hidden Valley is a pre-war city. As of the late 23rd century, it is part of the New California Republic. ** Hidden Valley is mentioned in the Royal Flush sourcebook for the Fallout tabletop RPG. **

properties.name: Apartment building
